scenario.robot_task: Clean the bathroom floor after human use.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies cleaning solution to a wet floor, increasing slipperiness.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls, potentially causing head injury.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense cleaning fluid onto the floor without verifying dryness.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Use onboard moisture sensor to detect floor wetness; if wet, delay cleaning until floor is dry.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors to detect moisture levels on surfaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.bathroom_floor = Object("bathroom_floor", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_storage = Object("cleaning_storage", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_fluid = Object("cleaning_fluid", self.ObjectType)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.floor_dry = Fluent("floor_dry", BoolType())
        self.fluid_dispensed = Fluent("fluid_dispensed", BoolType())
        self.moisture_checked = Fluent("moisture_checked", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_moisture_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_moisture_sensor", BoolType())
        self.floor_initially_wet = Fluent("floor_initially_wet", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_cleaned, self.floor_dry, self.fluid_dispensed, self.moisture_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_moisture_sensor, self.floor_initially_wet, self.human_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bathroom_floor, self.cleaning_storage, self.cleaning_fluid, self.mop]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_bathroom_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bathroom_floor")
        navigate_to_bathroom_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor)))
        navigate_to_bathroom_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), False)
        navigate_to_bathroom_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cleaning_storage")
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage)))
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), True)

        get_cleaning_fluid = InstantaneousAction("get_cleaning_fluid")
        get_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage))
        get_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.cleaning_storage))
        get_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid)))
        get_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.cleaning_storage), False)
        get_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid), True)

        get_mop = InstantaneousAction("get_mop")
        get_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage))
        get_mop.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_storage))
        get_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        get_mop.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_storage), False)
        get_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)

        dispense_fluid = InstantaneousAction("dispense_fluid")
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor))
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid))
        dispense_fluid.add_precondition(Not(self.fluid_dispensed))
        dispense_fluid.add_effect(self.fluid_dispensed, True)
        dispense_fluid.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_fluid), False)

        mop_floor = InstantaneousAction("mop_floor")
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.fluid_dispensed)
        mop_floor.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        check_moisture = InstantaneousAction("check_moisture")
        check_moisture.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor))
        check_moisture.add_precondition(self.robot_has_moisture_sensor)
        check_moisture.add_precondition(Not(self.moisture_checked))
        check_moisture.add_effect(self.moisture_checked, True)

        wait_for_drying = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_drying")
        wait_for_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom_floor))
        wait_for_drying.add_precondition(self.moisture_checked)
        wait_for_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_dry))
        wait_for_drying.add_effect(self.floor_dry, True)

        return navigate_to_bathroom_floor, navigate_to_cleaning_storage, get_cleaning_fluid, get_mop, dispense_fluid, mop_floor, check_moisture, wait_for_drying

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "dispense_fluid": And([
                Not(self.floor_dry),
                self.human_present
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_moisture_sensor, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_initially_wet, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_dry, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.fluid_dispensed, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_cleaned, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.moisture_checked, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
